summary: Hard cut in at 3.867 from the beach trio shot (S03). Low-angle medium close-up on a seaside beach, with the sun almost directly behind the subject. A horse-headed man wears a satin blue-violet suit, a coral polka-dot dagger collar, gold aviators, a gold chain, a gold watch and a gold ring. At 3.867 he is in right-facing profile, calm, mouth closed. On the next frame he whips his head and torso toward camera in about 3 frames (3.877-3.967), with heavy motion blur. At the same time his LEFT arm swings forward, then up and in, and lands as a raised fist with the thumb stuck out, pointing back toward his own head and over his shoulder ('this guy' / thumb-over-shoulder). The palm faces camera. The arrival grows into a big head-thrown-back open-mouth laugh that peaks on the beat at 4.066. He then nods down about 20 deg, bottoming around 4.30-4.40 (half-beat 4.310), while the fist dips about 0.15 stud. The head eases back up and the mouth closes into a clenched, gum-showing smug grin around 4.53-4.55 (beat 4.554). He holds that pose with only slight drift until the hard cut at 4.967 to S05 (gold chain close-up). The camera is locked off. The subtitle 'DO DO DO DO DO DO DO DO' stays on screen the whole shot. The 30 fps frames come from 24 fps animation: every 5th frame is a duplicate (0125=0126, 0130=0131, 0135=0136, 0140=0141).

camera.framing: Low-angle MEDIUM CLOSE-UP, 16:9. FINAL POSE (3.967-4.967): the bottom edge cuts across the horse's mid-chest and lapels; the ear tips and pompadour touch or graze the top edge. The head is centered horizontally (about 40-61% x, 0-62% y): glasses at 8-25% y, mouth at 27-37% y, chin at about 60% y overlapping the collar. The near (character's RIGHT) shoulder and upper arm is a huge purple mass filling the lower-left third (x 10-38%, y 50-100%). The coral collar, open shirt and gold chain form a V in the lower middle (x 28-58%, y 52-85%). The left fist with the thumb sits in the right third (fist 64-80% x, 45-60% y; gold watch 71-79% x, 62-68% y), with the forearm sleeve rising from the bottom edge at about 70-80% x. Bright sky fills about 65% of the frame. The sun glow is at about 34% x, 15% y, just left of and behind the head. The pier and sand appear only in the bottom ~20% (right and left edges). START FRAME (3.867): the horse is in pure right-facing profile. The head fills 35-74% x, 11-77% y, and the nose tip is at about 72% x, 60% y. The popped collar and the jacket's right shoulder and back fill the lower-left (22-65% x, 48-100% y). The sun glow is at upper-left (35% x, 17% y), behind the back of the head.
camera.position: Camera is about 3.4 studs horizontally from the horse's head, about 2.6-3.0 studs from the near right shoulder. Camera height is about 4.0 studs above the sand, which is the character's upper-chest level, about 0.7 stud below the shoulder tops (shoulders about 4.6-4.7 studs; horse head center about 5.6; ear tips about 6.4 studs). In the final pose the camera sits about 40 deg off the torso's front toward the character's RIGHT side. With the character root at the origin on the ground and the final torso facing -Z (character right = +X): camera at (2.2, 4.0, -2.6) looking at (0, 5.0, 0). The camera does not move. The character turns in place under it, starting rotated a further 65 deg to his own left.
camera.angle: Pitched UP about 16 deg (hero low angle; the sea horizon would sit at about 88-90% of frame height, just behind the pier legs). Yaw is centered on the head. Roll/dutch is about 0 deg (level). The low angle shows the underside of the jaw and chin and makes the near shoulder appear higher than the far shoulder.
camera.lensNotes: Moderately wide lens (about a 32 mm full-frame equivalent; vertical FOV about 40 deg, horizontal about 66 deg) used close to the subject. Perspective exaggeration makes the near shoulder look about 3x the size of the far shoulder. No fisheye or barrel distortion is visible. Depth of field is shallow: focus is on the face and glasses at about 3.4 studs, and the fist is nearly sharp. The pier and buildings (60-120 studs away) are strongly defocused into soft shapes, and the sand at the lower left is blurred. The sun behind the subject causes a large soft veiling bloom/halation (radius about 18-20% of frame height) that lifts the blacks in the upper-left quadrant and makes fur edges glow. There are no anamorphic streaks or ghost flares. The image is slightly soft overall, with mild compression.

movement.description: Hard cut in. Locked-off tripod camera, low angle, already framed for the final pose (the profile head starts center-right and lower in frame).

Optional single-frame micro jolt: the background shifts about 5 px of 854 (0.6% of frame width, about 0.02 stud) horizontally on the whip frame, then returns at 3.933. This sells the impact of the whip.
Static again for the rest of the shot. There is no pan, tilt, dolly or zoom; background scale is unchanged.
Imperceptible drift: the background creeps about 5 px to screen right between 4.07 and 4.93 (about 0.2 deg of pan to the left). Can be ignored or added as a 0.2 deg yaw drift for a 'live' feel.
Hard cut to S05 (extreme close-up of the gold Cuban chain on the chest fur, between the coral collars).

camera.shake: Effectively none: locked off. There is a single-frame horizontal jolt of about 0.6% of frame width at 3.900, synced to the head whip. No zoom or whip-pan. Do not add handheld noise.

subjects.who: Horse-headed man ('Aura Farmer' horse): an anthropomorphic, realistically furred CG horse head on a human body in a 70s pimp/disco suit
subjects.appearance: BODY: a human male body with a 5.5-stud adult build (shoulders about 4.6-4.7 studs), broad shoulders, with a horse head and thick horse neck on top; ear tips about 6.4 studs. The horse head is about 1.7 studs long from poll to muzzle, about 0.9 stud wide at the cheeks and about 0.8 stud wide at the muzzle, with a big heavy chin/jaw. FUR: dark chocolate brown to near-black. Core shadow #1A1716, muzzle and chin #0F1418 to #201D1F (velvety black). Warm brown highlights on the forehead, cheek and neck #4F3220 / #6D4E3A, with a rim-lit fur fringe glowing #8A6A55 on the silhouette. Thick neck #221E1E. MANE: an almost black (#1D1F1E) short mane styled as a spiky pompadour/quiff tuft rising between the ears (about 0.4 stud tall), plus mane down the back of the neck. EARS: upright pointed horse ears, brown #3A2C27 outside, lighter inside, about 0.45 stud long. NOSE: big dark nostrils #191A20 at the top of the muzzle. MOUTH: dark grey-black lips #232427. Big flat, square, human-like white teeth (lit #EDE5D5; measured in shade #916C61), with pink gums and inner lip #C98E7C and a pink tongue #C46E6A. EYES: dark brown and half-lidded behind the lenses. SUNGLASSES: large teardrop aviators with a thin metal double-bridge frame in silver-gold (#CBBDAD, highlights #EDE6DA). The lenses have an amber/brown gradient: dark #3B2A22 at the top, #9C6A45 / #B07A50 in the middle, pale peach #ECD9C0 at the bottom where they reflect the sky. They catch a bright white specular glint during the whip. They rest on the bridge of the muzzle, high on the face. JACKET: an oversized 70s suit jacket in satin/velour-sheen blue-violet with soft folds and big soft shoulders. Measured in shade #242C68 (midtone), #33396D (sheen), with a pale rim along the top of the shoulder #6C70A8. Suggested albedo is #3B3FA8: in backlit shade it renders down to the measured values. Matching sleeves (#262A54 in shade). SHIRT: worn open-necked, with a huge pointed 70s dagger collar laid OVER the jacket lapels. Coral/brick red: #A14A40 lit, #C98E7C highlight, #662B2F in shade. Small purple/violet polka dots #703565 / #A075A0, about 0.07 stud diameter, spaced about 0.15 stud. Dark chest fur shows in the open neck. JEWELRY: a thick gold Cuban-link chain on the chest (#D8B45A highlights, #76523A shadow) showing in the shirt opening (about 56% x, 78% y). A chunky gold link-bracelet watch (Rolex-style) on the LEFT wrist: #C7B796 highlight, #8C7D5D mid, #4A3A28 shadow, about 0.25 stud wide band. A gold signet ring with a flat round top (#B59A6A) on the LEFT middle finger. HANDS: furred, dark brown-black (#2E2626 to #342728), human-shaped hands.
subjects.placement: One subject, centered, standing on the sand. The head is at the frame's horizontal center and in the upper 60%. START (3.867): the body and head face screen-right in profile. The torso is about 105 deg from camera (slightly away), so we see his right side and the back of his collar. The head faces exactly screen-right (90 deg), so we see the right side of his face and the right lens of the aviators. He is NOT facing camera. FROM 3.967 TO THE END: the torso is turned about +38-40 deg toward screen right (camera sits off his front-right; his right shoulder is nearest the camera at screen left; his left shoulder is far, about 57% x). The face is almost toward camera (head about 15 deg toward screen right), and the eyes look straight into the lens. FACING CAMERA. The raised left fist is on screen right (his own left side), level with his chin and mouth and slightly in front of his left shoulder. The right arm hangs out of frame.

poseKeys.body: ROOT/TORSO: yaw +105 deg camera-relative (facing screen-right, 15 deg away from camera). In Roblox terms the root is rotated 65 deg toward his own LEFT from the final orientation. Torso upright with a slight forward hunch, chest pitched down about 5 deg. Hips and legs are out of frame; assume a relaxed stance with weight on the right leg. NECK/HEAD: yaw +90 deg camera-relative (perfect right profile; about 15 deg to his right relative to the torso). Pitch -10 deg: in natural horse carriage the muzzle points about 40 deg below horizontal in screen, and the nose tip is at about 72% x, 60% y. Roll 0. LEFT ARM: hidden on the far side of the body or below frame, hanging relaxed (shoulder abduction about 10 deg, flexion 0, elbow about 20 deg, wrist neutral, hand loose). RIGHT ARM: hanging at his side; only the rounded right shoulder and back of the jacket is visible at lower-left (shoulder abduction about 5 deg, elbow about 10 deg). Collar popped up behind the neck.
poseKeys.face: Mouth fully closed (0.0), lips relaxed. The visible mouth corner is turned up slightly in a smug half-smile. The right eye is visible behind the lens, half-lidded (upper lid about 50%), looking straight ahead to screen-right. Ears upright, tilted back about 15 deg. Aviators sit snugly on the nasal bridge. Calm and cool, a one-frame 'before' pose.

poseKeys.body: WHIP FRAME 1 (heavy directional motion blur). TORSO: yaw about +85 deg, starting to rotate toward camera (turning to his own right); chest neutral. HEAD: leads the turn. Yaw about +55 deg (three-quarter, muzzle still pointing screen-right and down), pitch 0, roll 0. Head center at about 60% x, 35% y. LEFT ARM: flung FORWARD in his facing direction, which is toward screen right. The arm is almost straight at shoulder height: shoulder flexion about 85 deg, abduction about 10 deg, elbow about 25 deg, wrist neutral. The hand is open/flat and blurred, palm down, with the gold watch on top. The hand is at the far right of the frame (about 93% x, 80% y) and the forearm crosses 70-87% x at about 81% y. RIGHT ARM: unchanged.
poseKeys.face: Mouth starting to open, about 0.2 (blurred). The aviator lens on the far side flares with a bright white sun glint. Ears start to lag outward.

poseKeys.body: WHIP FRAME 2 (heavy blur). TORSO: yaw about +65 deg; the lapels and the gold chain start to show (chain at about 57% x, 78% y). HEAD: yaw about +30 deg, pitch +8 deg (lifting), roll +10 deg (top of head tipping toward screen right, i.e. toward his own left shoulder, as follow-through). Head center at about 52% x, 25% y. LEFT ARM: sweeping up and inward on an arc. Shoulder abduction about 70 deg, flexion about 45 deg, external rotation about 40 deg; elbow bending to about 75 deg. The hand is at about 84% x, 60% y; the fingers are curling and the thumb is popping out toward screen-left and up. RIGHT ARM: hanging, with the shoulder now seen from the front-right.
poseKeys.face: Mouth about 0.45 open, teeth showing; laugh starting. The eyes have already found the camera. The left ear (screen right) is flung outward about 60 deg from vertical. The pompadour lags backward.

poseKeys.body: ARRIVAL (light blur). TORSO: yaw about +45 deg, leaning back about 5 deg, chest facing camera-right. HEAD: yaw +15 deg, pitch +18 deg (thrown back: we look up under the jaw), roll +15 deg (top tilted toward screen right). The ear tips touch the top edge. The nose is at about 49% x, 25% y. LEFT ARM: upper arm out to the side and slightly forward (shoulder abduction about 55 deg, flexion about 25 deg, external rotation about 70 deg). The elbow is bent about 110 deg and sits low and out at about 76% x, 78% y. The forearm is almost vertical, top leaning about 10 deg toward screen left. The wrist is extended about 10 deg. HAND: a tight fist with the thumb fully extended (thumb CMC abducted about 60 deg, MCP 0, IP 0-10 deg), pointing horizontally to screen LEFT, toward his own head and back over his shoulder. The palm faces camera. Fingers 2-5 are curled tight (MCP about 90 deg, PIP about 100 deg, DIP about 60 deg); the curled finger segments and the ring face camera. The fist is at about 71% x, 55% y and the watch at about 75% x, 67% y. RIGHT ARM: relaxed down; only the shoulder mass is visible at screen left.
poseKeys.face: Mouth about 0.6 open, laughing. Upper and lower teeth are visible and the lips are pulled back wide at the corners. The eyes are half-lidded behind the lenses, looking into the lens. The left ear is still swung out about 70 deg from vertical; the mane tuft is bent back.

poseKeys.body: Still moving (slight blur on the head and hand). TORSO: yaw about +40 deg. HEAD: yaw +12 deg, pitch +20 deg, roll +12 deg. LEFT FIST rising: about 71% x, 54% y; elbow about 112 deg. Everything else as at 3.967.
poseKeys.face: Mouth about 0.65 open, laugh building. Ear springing back to about 55 deg.

poseKeys.body: TORSO: yaw +38 deg, leaning back about 7 deg. HEAD: yaw +12 deg, pitch +22 deg, roll +8 deg. LEFT FIST overshooting upward to about 68% x, 50% y, with the thumb tip at about 60% x, 49% y. Elbow about 118 deg, shoulder abduction 55 deg, flexion 30 deg.
poseKeys.face: Mouth about 0.85, a wide 'HA!'. The jaw drops about 22 deg. The upper lip curls up and shows pink gums; the pink tongue is visible. Ear about 40 deg.

poseKeys.body: ACCENT FRAME, ON THE BEAT (4.066). TORSO: yaw +38 deg, leaning back about 8 deg with the chest proud; shoulders level. HEAD: at its highest throw-back. Yaw +12 deg, pitch +22 deg, roll +6 deg. The nose is at about 53% x, 27% y and the ear tips are at the top edge. LEFT ARM: the fist is at its highest. Fist center about 71% x, 48% y; thumb tip about 63% x, 48% y; watch about 72% x, 61% y. Elbow about 120 deg, shoulder abduction 55 deg, flexion 30 deg, external rotation 70 deg, wrist extended 10 deg, palm to camera. RIGHT ARM: relaxed out of frame.
poseKeys.face: PEAK LAUGH: mouth 0.9 open. The jaw drops about 25 deg. Lips are pulled back, showing both rows of big flat white teeth and pink upper gums; the tongue is visible in the dark mouth. The eyes squint, half-lidded. Ears almost upright (about 25 deg outward). The pompadour springs upright.

poseKeys.body: Holding near the peak, starting to settle. TORSO: +38 deg, lean back 7 deg. HEAD: yaw +15 deg, pitch +15 deg, roll +4 deg; nose at about 54% x, 30% y. LEFT FIST: holding at about 73% x, 48% y; watch about 72% x, 61% y. The thumb is still pointing horizontally to screen-left, maybe 5 deg up.
poseKeys.face: Mouth closing, about 0.65. Lips still pulled back; teeth and gums visible. Ears upright and settled.

poseKeys.body: Nod in progress (sine in-out). HEAD: pitch +8 deg, yaw +16 deg, roll +3 deg; nose at about 55% x, 36% y. LEFT HAND: dipping down with the head bob; watch about 74% x, 63% y; elbow about 112 deg.
poseKeys.face: Mouth about 0.45; the grin is forming as the lip corners stretch wider.

poseKeys.body: BOTTOM OF THE NOD (lands on half-beat 4.310). HEAD: pitch about +2 deg (about 20 deg lower than the peak), yaw +18 deg, roll +3 deg. The nose has dropped about 0.35 stud and moved slightly right to about 56% x, 40% y; the top of the head barely moves, so it is a pivot at the top of the neck. LEFT ARM: settled about 0.15 stud lower and about 0.1 stud further out to screen right. Fist about 77% x, 55% y; thumb tip about 68% x, 50% y; watch about 76% x, 66% y. Elbow about 108 deg, shoulder abduction about 50 deg. TORSO: unchanged yaw +38 deg, lean back eased to about 4 deg.
poseKeys.face: Mouth about 0.3, teeth slightly parted in a wide toothy grin. Lips pulled back hard; upper gums show.

poseKeys.body: Holding the bottom of the nod. HEAD: pitch +2 deg, yaw +18 deg, roll +3 deg; nose about 56% x, 39% y. Hand static at about 77% x, 55% y.
poseKeys.face: Mouth about 0.15. Teeth nearly together; the grin widens.

poseKeys.body: Head easing back up (sine out). Pitch about +7 deg, yaw +16 deg, roll +3 deg; nose about 55% x, 36% y. The hand creeps about 1 px up and holds (fist about 76% x, 54% y). Torso static.
poseKeys.face: Mouth snaps shut into a clenched grin by about 4.55 (beat 4.554), about 0.05 open. Teeth together and fully bared. The upper lip curls up in a sneer-smile, showing pink gums. The cheeks bunch. Eyes half-lidded, cocky, into the lens.

poseKeys.body: FINAL HOLD POSE reached. TORSO: yaw +38 deg, lean back about 4 deg, shoulders level. Right shoulder big and close at screen left; right arm hanging out of frame. HEAD: yaw +15 deg (face slightly toward screen right, so his right cheek and jaw read big at screen left), pitch +10 deg (chin up, cocky), roll about +3 deg; nose about 54% x, 33% y. LEFT ARM: shoulder abduction about 50 deg, flexion about 25 deg, external rotation about 70 deg; elbow about 108 deg, low and out of frame at the bottom right; forearm near vertical; wrist extended 10 deg. Fist center about 76% x, 54% y; thumb tip about 67% x, 49% y pointing horizontally to screen-left toward his head; watch about 75% x, 66% y; palm and curled fingers with the gold ring face camera.
poseKeys.face: Clenched toothy smug grin (mouth 0.03). Wide horizontal lip stretch. The upper lip is curled and lifted, more on the screen-left side, showing pink gums. Eyes half-lidded behind amber lenses, looking straight into the lens. Ears upright, relaxed outward about 20 deg.

poseKeys.body: Moving hold, the last frame before the cut. Head pitch +11 deg, yaw +15 deg, roll +3 deg (drift of 1 deg or less); nose about 54% x, 31% y. Torso yaw +38 deg. Fist static at about 76% x, 54% y; watch about 75% x, 65% y. A slight breathing rise of the chest (0.02 stud) is fine.
poseKeys.face: Same clenched gummy grin (0.03), eyes into camera. Hold until the cut at 4.967.

subjects.motionNotes: Rhythm: the turn starts 1 frame after the cut and is a very snappy whip, about 0.09-0.1 s (3.877-3.967), with an exponential/quint ease-out. The head leads the torso by about 1 frame. The arm trails on a big arc: hanging, then forward-horizontal at 3.900, then up and in at 3.933, then the raised fist at 3.967. There is heavy directional motion blur on 3.900-3.967 and light blur at 4.000. OVERSHOOT: after arriving, the head keeps pitching back into a laugh and peaks exactly on beat 4.066 (pitch +22 deg). The fist overshoots about 0.1 stud above its final rest at 4.03-4.17. SETTLE/BOUNCE: from 4.07 to 4.30 the head nods down about 20 deg (sine in-out) and the fist dips about 0.15 stud and drifts about 0.1 stud outward at the same time, as one 'bounce' that bottoms at half-beat 4.310. It holds to about 4.43, then the head eases back up about 8 deg by 4.63 (sine out). The mouth closes into the clenched grin near beat 4.554. After 4.63 it is a moving hold with 1 deg or less of drift. SECONDARY: the ears fling outward on the whip (about 70 deg at 3.967) and spring back with damped follow-through (55 deg at 4.000, 40 deg at 4.033, 25 deg at 4.067, settled about 20 deg by 4.167). The pompadour tuft bends back during the whip and springs upright at 4.03-4.1. The jacket shoulder fabric and collar points lag about 2 frames. The gold chain swings and settles by 4.2. The mouth opening tracks the head pitch (biggest at the peak), then closes gradually: 0.9 at 4.067, 0.65 at 4.167, 0.45 at 4.233, 0.3 at 4.300, 0.15 at 4.400, then 0.03 at 4.533. The source animation is 24 fps: on 30 fps every 5th frame is held.

set: Sunny British-style seaside beach (Blackpool-like). GROUND: flat sand, light brown (#867267 / #7D6C5F as seen blurred and in shade; suggested albedo #C9B49A). It is visible only at the bottom-left and bottom edge, because the low angle puts the horizon at about 88-90% of frame height. BACKGROUND RIGHT: a Victorian pleasure pier running away from camera to the right, about 60-100 studs away. Its deck is a dark teal-grey band (#2A3C3F) about 10 studs above the sand, about 3 studs thick, with railings. It stands on many thin pale cylindrical legs (#C7BEBF lit) going down to the sea, spaced about 8 studs. A long low pavilion or kiosk building sits on the deck at the far right (#3D5560 with a lighter roof, about 20 x 4 studs). All of it is heavily defocused. BACKGROUND LEFT: further away (about 120 studs), low seafront buildings and the start of another pier or promenade with faint amusement-ride / Ferris-wheel silhouettes (grey-blue #2F4650), very blurred, at 0-22% x, 78-88% y. SEA: a pale grey-lilac hazy strip at the horizon between the pier legs (#C7C2CB / #9899A1). SKY: clear and cloudless. Gradient from deep blue #336685 in the top corners, to #6287A5 mid-right and #6A93B2 mid-left, to pale haze #BCC5CD near the horizon. A white glow (#E6E6E4) surrounds the sun at about 34% x, 15% y. No foreground props: the character alone fills the foreground.
lighting: KEY = SUN, almost directly BEHIND the subject: backlight about 12 deg left of the camera axis and about 30 deg elevation. The sun itself is hidden by or just left of the head and neck. It blows out the sky around it to white with a large soft bloom (radius about 18-20% of frame height) and gives a strong warm-white rim/halo on all silhouette edges: fur fringe on the ears, pompadour, neck and cheek glows about #8A6A55 to #E0D0C0; the top edge of the near shoulder catches a pale blue-white rim (#6C70A8 to #BFC3E0). FILL: soft cool skylight plus warm sand bounce from the front and below. The camera-facing surfaces are in open shade, so the fur reads dark (#1A1716) and the jacket is a saturated deep blue-violet (#242C68 to #33396D). Subject contrast is low to medium, with no hard shadows on the face. Teeth and gold catch soft speculars (watch highlights #C7B796, glasses frame #EDE6DA). The aviator lenses reflect the sky as a gradient (#3B2A22 top to #ECD9C0 bottom) and flash a bright specular glint at 3.900-3.933. COLOR: daylight about 5600-6000 K, cool sky and shadows, warm highlights. Saturation is moderately high on the jacket (blue-violet) and collar (coral). Exposure is set for the subject's shaded side, so the sky near the sun clips to white. Contrast is mildly lowered by veiling glare in the upper-left quadrant. FLARE: soft veiling bloom and halation only; no hexagon ghosts and no streaks.

effects.description: Hard cut in from S03 (trio on the beach, subtitle 'THE AURA FARMER'). The subtitle switches to 'DO DO DO DO DO DO DO DO' on the same frame.

Heavy directional motion blur on the head, torso and the swinging left arm (blur streaks run screen-right to left along the turn). A bright white-orange specular glint flashes on the aviator lens. Optional 1-frame camera micro jolt of about 0.02 stud.
Motion blur continues on the head and the up-sweeping hand (smear about 10% of frame width). The ear and mane are smeared.
Blur reduces: the hand and head are lightly smeared; the fist is mostly readable.
Last frame with slight blur on the hand and watch. From 4.033 on, everything is sharp.

Throughout the shot: soft sun bloom/halation glow at the upper-left-center (34% x, 15% y) partly behind the head; atmospheric haze toward the horizon; shallow-DoF bokeh on the pier and beach; a light rim glow on the fur edges.
Hard cut out to S05 (extreme close-up of the gold Cuban chain and coral collars). The subtitle continues unchanged into the next shot.

subtitle: 'DO DO DO DO DO DO DO DO' (eight 'DO's) is on screen for the entire shot, 3.867-4.967. It appears at the cut, replacing 'THE AURA FARMER', and continues into the next shot with no animation. Style: heavy bold italic sans-serif, all caps. Fill is a vertical gradient from golden yellow #F8D23A at the top through orange #F38836 to red-orange #EA523D at the bottom. It has a dark maroon outline (#72000D, about 1.5 px at 480p) and a solid maroon drop shadow offset about 2 px down and right, giving a 3D look. Centered horizontally, spanning about 28%-72% of frame width (x 237-617 of 854). Vertical center at about 92% of frame height. Cap height about 22 px of 480 (about 4.6% of frame height).
recreateInRoblox:
TIMELINE: build the shot as a 1.100 s clip (local 0.000 = 3.867 absolute) at 30 fps; Moon Animator 2 or the Animation Editor with Curve Editor both work. Add markers at 4.066 (local 0.199, laugh peak), 4.310 (0.443, nod bottom) and 4.554 (0.687, grin closes).

CHARACTER: start from an R15 rig at 5.5-stud adult scale. Hide the default head. Build a horse head MeshPart (or a union) about 1.7 L x 0.9 W x 1.1 H studs, plus a thick neck part (about 0.85 diameter, 0.7 tall). Weld the head to a custom Neck Motor6D whose pivot sits at the top of the neck, behind the ears, so a pitch makes the nose dip while the ears barely move. Add separate Motor6D parts for: the lower jaw (hinged at the cheek; rotate 0 to 25 deg for mouth open 0 to 1), the upper lip (curls 0 to 15 deg), both ears (for flop), and the pompadour tuft (for spring). Teeth: flat white blocks #EDE5D5 in an upper and a lower row. Gums: a pink strip #C98E7C. Tongue: #C46E6A. Fur: use SurfaceAppearance with a fur ColorMap and NormalMap; or Fabric material #2A211F with the muzzle in #141619. Aviators: a thin Metal frame (#CBBDAD) and Glass lenses (Color #A8723F, Transparency 0.15, Reflectance 0.3), or a SurfaceAppearance gradient from dark at the top to peach at the bottom. Jacket: layered clothing or welded MeshParts with puffy shoulders, color #3B3FA8, SmoothPlastic or Fabric with Reflectance about 0.03 for a satin sheen (this renders to about #242C68 in backlit shade). Collar: two big wedge 'dagger' collars laid over the lapels, #C4523F with a polka-dot Texture (#7A3E8E dots). Chain: Cuban link mesh in Foil #D8B45A. Watch: a ring of small Foil blocks #C9A84C on the LEFT wrist. A gold ring on the LEFT middle finger. LEFT HAND: replace it with a custom fist mesh that has a separate thumb part on its own Motor6D (thumb fully extended, pointing medially when the palm faces forward).

STAGING (final pose): HumanoidRootPart at the origin on the ground; final torso facing -Z. Camera: CameraType Scriptable, FieldOfView 40, CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(2.2, 4.0, -2.6), Vector3.new(0, 5.0, 0)). It is static. Optionally, on local 0.033 only, offset it 0.02 stud along its RightVector for the jolt. Start pose: root yaw rotated +65 deg about Y (CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(65), 0) turns him to his LEFT, so he faces screen-right, slightly away). The neck is turned about 15 deg to his right relative to the torso, pitched -10 deg, mouth closed.

The left arm uses an intermediate key at 0.033 (arm straight forward at shoulder height), then 0.066 (abduction 70 deg, elbow 75 deg), then 0.100 (raised fist). Head pitch goes from -10 to +22 by 0.200 with Back Out (the laugh peak lands on the 4.066 beat), then a nod to +2 deg at 0.433 (Sine InOut), hold to 0.53, rise to +10 deg at 0.77 (Sine Out), then a moving hold. The fist dips 0.15 stud between 0.20 and 0.43, together with the nod. Ears: damped spring keys (70, 55, 40, 25, 15, 20 deg on 3.967 through 4.167). Mouth: 0.0, 0.2, 0.45, 0.6, 0.85, 0.9 (4.067), 0.65, 0.45, 0.3, 0.15, then 0.03 from 4.533.
